hooking_technique: Insert the hook into the bottom part of the corn kernel
Cut the tip of the corn to expose the core
Use a smaller hook (size 6 or 3) for larger tilapia
additional_notes: Stale corn (milho azedo) is recommended for its juice as an attractant
Rabbit feed (ração de coelho) can be used as bait but is less effective when corn is the primary bait
